purpose: Use a fresh local container to compare bounded GET and POST detection surfaces without promoting weak signals.

channels.GET: query parameter carrying an inert per-episode marker
channels.POST: application/x-www-form-urlencoded form carrying the same kind of inert marker
channels.HEAD: preflight only; never sufficient for this family

episode_contract: recreate the pinned container before each independent episode
take an unmarked baseline for both methods
send only a bounded alphanumeric marker; no script, SQL, command, credential, or state-changing probe
derive body/header/status projections and allow-listed regex evidence in memory
discard raw response and marker; retain only hashes and bounded summaries
positive_gate: two independent positive replays per case
three target instances and three sampling seeds

failure_policy.unsupported_post_surface: engineering_observation; do not infer a vulnerability
